description: Change a poll interval in an INI file indented under a section with blank-line separators. DISTILL-CANARY-ccaeb500

files.ops/poller.conf.ini:
[sync]
poll_every_s = 45     ; lower = more load
chunk_rows = 200

[cleanup]
poll_every_s = 600    ; hourly is too slow
chunk_rows = 50

turns.prompt: Set the sync job's poll_every_s to 30 in ops/poller.conf.ini and leave cleanup alone. Reply DONE when it's done.

ops/poller.conf.ini.equals:
[sync]
poll_every_s = 30     ; lower = more load
chunk_rows = 200

[cleanup]
poll_every_s = 600    ; hourly is too slow
chunk_rows = 50
